name: Shinju no Mimikazari no Otoko
source:
"I" am an art student majoring in oil painting who came across a suit-clad older man when looking for a model for my painting.

He said, "Please draw my portrait. I don't need to be paid. But please draw these earrings."
They were the earrings of his late wife. These pearl earrings hid a mysterious light that could be called a 'curse' and when they were put on his left ear…

He told me that Kanako, his wife who passed away two years ago, was an art student attending the same university as "me". The years passed and before "I" knew it, "I" had begun to fall in love with this soft-spoken man. "I" proposed a secret arrangement to him that we would embrace whenever he came to my studio.

"The pearl that you cannot take off… if it is a curse cast by Kanako then I cannot draw you if you do not become one with her emotions."

Sex with him was something "I" had never experienced before; it brought about a dazzlingly profound ecstasy… 

[Edited from http://koyonplete.com/man-with-a-pearl-earring]
translation:
“我”是一名主修油画的艺术系学生，为寻找绘画模特而遇见了一位身穿西装的年长男子。

他说：“请为我画肖像。不需要付钱。但请画下这对耳环。”
那是他已故妻子的耳环。这对珍珠耳环藏着一种神秘光芒，甚至可以称为“诅咒”。当它们被戴上他的左耳……

他告诉“我”，两年前去世的妻子香奈子曾是与“我”就读同一所大学的艺术系学生。时光流逝，等“我”回过神来，已经爱上了这位寡言温柔的男人。“我”向他提出秘密约定：每当他来画室时，两人就拥抱。

“无法摘下的珍珠……如果这是香奈子施加的诅咒，那么除非你与她的感情融为一体，否则我无法为你画像。”

与他的性爱是“我”从未体验过的事，带来了耀眼而深邃的狂喜……
